working: In Solanaceae the flowers are bisexual and actinomorphic, so (a) is true. The calyx has five united sepals and is persistent, so (b) is true. The androecium has five epipetalous stamens, so (c) is true. The ovary is bicarpellary, syncarpous and superior, not inferior, so (d) is false. The correct statements are (a), (b) and (c), which is option 1.
